correctness.rationale: The generic local-ring calculation is exact: the jet ideal has linear edge relations after inverting all first-order coordinates, graph parity identifies remaining variables, and the edge monomials impose independent square-zero relations. The separate 2,457-case checker matches but is only supporting finite evidence.

value.rationale: An explicit 2025 paper asks for primary components and multiplicities of graph jet schemes. This answers the canonical central component for every isolate-free finite graph and all characteristics, giving its full generic Artin algebra and revealing a structural characteristic-two difference that reduced varieties hide.
